intent: two preview-only complete page concepts; not implementation; neither user approved

prompts.A:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity, complete desktop web app page screenshot for a Chinese professional character-reference image editor. The user wants actual full-page product screen design, not a wireframe, not a marketing presentation, not a photograph of a monitor. Flat front-on screenshot filling the entire image, landscape 16:10, target 1920x1200 or a similar large legible resolution. All interface copy in clean, readable simplified Chinese sans-serif. Existing product identity: restrained charcoal surfaces, slightly green-tinted dark neutrals, off-white type, subtle gray separators, one mint/emerald accent only for the actual generate button and editing selection. No purple, gradients, glass, AI sparkle logos, giant decorative headings, device/browser chrome, annotations, numbered workflow steps or excessive boxes. The physical scene is an artist working for long periods in the existing dim dark-themed image workbench. The most prominent content must be real character photographs, followed by the current editing input and action.
Character content across ALL images: same realistic East Asian male fantasy warrior, about45 years old, stern expression, heavy eyebrows, swept-back black hair in a topknot with a small black metal crown, thick black beard, heavy black segmented armor with subtle metallic details. Consistent identity, gray studio background, realistic photographic rendering. Front headshot, strict left-facing90degree profile headshot, a full-body straight front view and a full-body back view with matching armor; feet fully visible in full-body images. Original reference thumbnail is the same character's original painted design. The four candidate images are FOUR subtly different LEFT-facing pure profile portraits of this SAME person, no identity, costume or direction changes. They are arranged exactly2x2. This is one selected character being subtly refined, not four different people.
Screen content and invariants: compact top toolbar with title '角色参考图', editable role name '黑甲武士', quiet right actions '保存成品', '复制', '下载'. NO 1-4 step navigation and no wizard. Original source stays at left with NO filename. Lower left must show image-based historical batches '侧脸历史', '第8组', '第7组', '第6组', current batch differentiated subtly. All candidate selection is image-based, never text dropdowns. The finished composition must show all FOUR views with labels '正脸', '侧脸', '正面全身', '背面全身'. Portraits are top row, matching full-body front/back bottom row. Mark the existing side portrait as the currently edited region, but do not pretend a new candidate has already been adopted.
An editable textarea labeled '补充要求', containing exactly '鼻梁再收一点，下颌与胡须保持，仍然是同一个人。' must be visible together with the final composition AND all four new candidates in the same screen. A proper primary button '生成4个侧脸候选' must sit DIRECTLY BELOW the textarea, not to its side and not above it. Count segmented control '4个' and '9个', with4 selected, belongs BEFORE the textarea. Secondary recognizable controls '生成设置' and '本图提示词' stay quiet, no full model/provider configuration forms.
The four candidates are clearly a separate group '本次候选' / '第8组'. Small unobtrusive cell indices1,2,3,4. Candidate3 may be subtly focused with a mint border and a small '用这张' action. No image filenames, long metadata or explanation strips under images. Maintain sufficient image sizes to compare facial details, tight predictable alignment, readable text, comfortable targets, compact and task-led. Entire page and all core controls inside the image, nothing cut off. Render complete high-fidelity Chinese UI with photographic image content, not blank placeholders. No design-direction title or explanation banner inside the product itself.
DIRECTION A: COMPOSITION ALWAYS PROMINENT. This is the FIRST of two different UX concepts. Use three carefully proportioned columns in one complete screen: narrow left material/history rail about200px, generous center final-composition stage about1000px, medium-wide right editor/candidate panel about600px. Top toolbar around64px high,16-24px gutters. The center main stage titled '成品预览' shows a large, balanced portrait-format four-view sheet occupying almost the full usable height. Head portraits top, full-body figures below. All four photos visible and their outer frames perfectly aligned; the current side slot has a thin mint outline. Above the sheet only a quiet '草稿已保存', no oversized dashboard boxes.
Right column, from top to bottom: title '调整侧脸' and quiet '本图提示词'; tiny face reference thumbnail with '参考当前正脸'; compact4/9 count control; the filled '补充要求' textarea; PRIMARY GENERATE BUTTON immediately under the textarea; collapsed '生成设置' as a quiet text row. Then '本次候选' with '第8组' inline and all FOUR large enough profile portraits in a neat2x2 grid. The right candidates can be about250x250 each so details are genuinely visible; design the input compactly so both candidate rows fit within screen height. The textarea/button/candidate area must all be visible simultaneously, without scrolling, while the full composition remains large in center. Left original image compact near top, left lower area three thumb-and-batch rows. This concept emphasizes seeing the WHOLE finished character sheet while changing a single part. Polish it like a usable production screen, restrained visual hierarchy and precise spacing.

DIRECTION B: LARGE CANDIDATE COMPARISON WITH A BOTTOM INPUT DOCK. Create the SECOND complete page concept using the supplied first concept only to preserve the SAME character image identity, same black armor, original reference, Chinese product vocabulary and dark mint visual system. Radically RECOMPOSE THE LAYOUT. This must be a genuinely different UX direction from the supplied three-column page, not a color variation.
Only TWO major columns: narrow LEFT contextual rail about300px, and the broad MAIN comparison/editing area covering the rest of a1920x1200 landscape screen. NO right sidebar. Keep compact top toolbar with title/role name and save/copy/download actions.
Left rail order: a compact '原始素材' thumbnail near top; BELOW it a complete miniature FOUR-VIEW finished sheet titled '当前成品' (front portrait+left-facing profile on top, full-body front+back below, all four visible); BELOW that '侧脸历史' with picture-based batch rows '第8组', '第7组', '第6组'. Thumbnail of current composition must be large enough to recognize all four poses and locate the edited side-head slot by a subtle mint outline. No filename and no long caption blocks.
MAIN AREA upper about730px height: heading '侧脸候选比较', small text link '返回成品', tiny '本图提示词' utility. A calm narrow reference column within main area shows '当前正脸' head photo above '当前侧脸' head photo, at least180px wide each, so the user sees identity and the actual existing version while comparing. To their right, FOUR much larger profile candidates in a2x2 arrangement, ideally around320-380px per tile. Numbers1-4 discreetly overlaid. Candidate3 has a thin mint border and one compact '用这张' button. ALL four candidates simultaneously visible, same person and direction, only subtle nose/jaw differences. Candidate photos dominate this concept, while the whole composition remains visible in the left rail.
MAIN AREA BOTTOM about230px height is a WIDE, in-page fixed editing dock. It is not a modal and does not overlap or obscure any image. It spans the whole main area horizontally and sits directly beneath the comparison region. It contains one compact row '调整侧脸' with count segmented '4个' selected / '9个'; then a wide filled textarea labeled '补充要求' containing '鼻梁再收一点，下颌与胡须保持，仍然是同一个人。'; then BELOW this textarea an action row with quiet collapsed '生成设置' on left and the mint primary '生成4个侧脸候选' on right. Crucially the generate button is BELOW the input, never alongside it. Tight functional spacing, roughly88px tall textarea and44px high button. All composer controls and all candidate rows must fit inside the screen with normal top/bottom padding, without scroll or clipping. No extra forms, banners, instructions or fake status statistics.
The payoff of this direction: user can type at the bottom and compare four large side portraits directly above, without losing the small current full composition and the current front/side references. Preserve the restrained polished production screen, real photographic character imagery, readable Chinese, restrained subtle borders and no decorative flourishes. NO third right inspector column. Entire full page, no outside annotations or direction titles.
